errors.stem: Systems may be more bureaucratic because of 37 ______ factors (state controls)

errors.note: 整空。括号里的 state controls 就是 external 的例子，题干已经把答案范围缩到「形容词」。听到 external rather than internal 时别被 internal 反填。

errors.stem: the type of work (higher absence among employees in 34 ______)

errors.stem: employees' 32 ______ (but the evidence is inconclusive)

errors.stem: enhancing the effectiveness of 37 ______ between patients, doctors, and staff

errors.stem: Friday: read 9 ______ in the class

errors.stem: Wednesday: watch a 7 ______ film

errors.stem: Telephone number: 4 ______
errors.ev: My mobile's broken at the moment. The number is eight nine four six zero seven three three.

errors.stem: The upper limit of age: 3 ______
errors.ev: Up until last year, the cutoff was twenty, but we raised the maximum to twenty-two this year.
errors.note: twenty 是去年的上限，今年改成 twenty-two。两个数字挨着出现，先出来的那个通常是干扰。

errors.stem: Extra requests: Equipment to be hired: a 9 ______
errors.ev: But you can hire other equipment, like a wetsuit, for a small fee.
errors.note: 复合词只抓到后半 suit，漏了 wet。题干 a 后面的名词是单数可数，suit 单写也成立，所以只能靠音和词库判断。

errors.stem: Indoor activities: • 8 ______ (David and Maria)
errors.ev: We'll also be offering a new course which hasn't been advertised yet, cookery. That's to replace woodwork.

errors.ev: David's done a lot of drama, so he'd like to do that. Maria is a bit shy, but I think it would be good for her.

errors.stem: Swimming (David would like to try for the 6 ______ swimming certificate)
errors.ev: we're only offering the gold certificate this year. We didn't get much interest in the silver and platinum awards last year.
errors.note: silver、platinum 都是去年的，今年只有 gold。realistic 原文里根本不存在，属于听串后自行补词。

errors.stem: 4 ______ (Maria only)
errors.ev: And my daughter would like to try surfing.

errors.stem: Activities selected: Sports: 3 ______ (both have some experience)
errors.ev: last summer, the whole family went sailing, and they really enjoyed it, so I think it would be nice for them to do that again.
errors.note: 整空着，不是写错是整句没跟上。题干括号 (both have some experience) 就是定位钩子——听到『全家都玩过』立刻准备写。

errors.stem: Start date: Saturday, 2 ______
errors.ev: ...a course which begins on the twenty-seventh of June and finishes on the fourth of July.
errors.note: 问开始日期，填了结束日期；fourth 拼成 forth；还把题号 2 一起写进去了。同一句里给了两个日期，先看题干问哪个。

errors.stem: Contact address: 1 ______ Street, Boston, MA 02116
errors.ev: Four hundred and sixty-three Beacon Street. That's B-E-A-C-O-N Street, Boston, MA oh two one one six.
errors.note: 题干已经印了 Street，空格要的是「门牌号 + 街名」。只写 Beacon 丢了 463。限字 NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER，463 Beacon 正好合规。

errors.stem: Q38: It is common for historians to play a major role in creating historical documentaries for television.
errors.ev: (Para B) with a few notable exceptions, professional historians have tended to avoid involvement in television programmes about history... (除了少数例外，专业历史学家倾向于避免参与有关历史的电视节目...)
errors.note: - 定位遗漏：没有注意到B段中的 "television programmes" 和 "avoid involvement" (避免参与)。 - 矛盾关系判断失败：原文说“避免参与”（不常见，不扮演主要角色），题干说“扮演主要角色是常见的”，两者直接矛盾，必须选NO。；- 识别绝对/程度词：题干的 "common" (常见) 和 "major role" 比较绝对。原文的 "avoid" 直接反驳了这一点。 - 寻找同义替换：documentaries (纪录片) 包含在 television programmes (电视节目) 中。；定位遗漏 (未识别出电视节目对应纪录片)
errors.src: 雅思阅读错题整理表 (Part 3: 历史研究与媒介)

errors.stem: Q31: How current student events are sometimes captured for future audiences
errors.ev: (Para B) many schools, too, produce video yearbooks. All these visual records may well prove to be invaluable sources of information for future historians. (许多学校也制作视频年鉴。所有这些视觉记录很可能会被证明是未来历史学家极其宝贵的信息来源。)
errors.note: - 抓错主语：被C段最后一句 "record current events for the benefit of future historians" 吸引，忽略了题干主语是 student events（学生事件）。 - 匹配失误：B段的 "schools produce video yearbooks" 完美对应学生事件的捕捉，"future historians" 对应 future audiences。；- 圈定主语限定词：题干中的定语（如 student）是绝对的定位核心，必须在原文中找到对应的具体场景（school, yearbook），不能只看后半句。；定位偏移 (忽略了题干主语的限定)
errors.src: 雅思阅读错题整理表 (Part 3: 历史研究与媒介)

errors.stem: Q40: Developments in technology are influencing a range of academic subjects.
errors.ev: (通篇只讨论了 technology (film/video) 对 history 这一门学科的影响，未提及 a range of academic subjects。)
errors.note: - 范围扩大（以偏概全）：原文通篇都在讲电影/视频技术对 历史学（history） 的影响。题干扩大到了 a range of academic subjects（一系列学术科目）。虽然常识上这是对的，但原文未提及。；- 警惕绝对/范围词：看到 a range of, all, various 等扩大范围的词，立刻去原文核对，如果原文只说了某一个特定事物（如history），而题干扩大到了一类，通常选 NG。；范围扩大 (将单一学科扩大为一系列学科
errors.src: 雅思阅读错题整理表 (Part 3: 历史研究与媒介)

errors.stem: Q35: A list of requirements that historians see as obstacles to their use of film to record history
errors.ev: (Para E) historians have rejected the training, the institutions, the motivations and the professional structures that would be needed in order to use moving images effectively. (历史学家拒绝了有效使用动态图像所需的培训、制度、动机和专业结构。)
errors.note: - 混淆段落主旨：G段虽然提到了cost, technical skills等担忧，但主旨是“好处大于担忧”，是在驳斥这些障碍。E段才是真正列举（list）了历史学家因为体制和技能要求（training, skills）而拒绝使用电影。；- 注意题干的情感色彩：题干说“被视为障碍的要求(requirements)”，E段列举了哪些要求被拒绝（training, structures），完美契合。；因果倒置 (把G段的反驳当成了E段的障碍列举)
errors.src: 雅思阅读错题整理表 (Part 3: 历史研究与媒介)

errors.stem: Q36: The needs of students in school have led to improvements in the teaching of history.
errors.ev: (文中无直接对应) B段提到了 schools produce video yearbooks，但并没有提到“学生的需求导致了历史教学的改进”。
errors.note: - 过度推断/强加因果：考生可能凭借常识认为“学生喜欢视频，所以促进了教学”，或者因为文中没明确说，就错误地选了NO。NOT GIVEN 的逻辑是：文中既没有确认这个因果关系，也没有否认。；- 警惕因果关系词：看到 A lead to B，去原文找 A 和 B，看它们是否被放在一起并构成了因果。如果没有提及这层因果，果断选 NG。 - 常识不代入：严格依据文本，不要自己脑补逻辑。；强加因果 (原文未提及因果关系却主观臆断)
errors.src: 雅思阅读错题整理表 (Part 3: 历史研究与媒介)

errors.stem: Q29: A reference to some differences between oral and written communication
errors.ev: (Para F) Film has reintroduced the oral form... oral communication is not limited to words: it also includes body language... Little of this is evident in a written transcript. (口头交流不仅限于语言：还包括肢体语言...这些在书面记录中很少见。)
errors.note: - 定位未紧扣对比关系：题干要求找“口头与书面的差异(differences)”。E段只提到了书面文字是行业媒介，并未对比两者。F段明确列出了口头(含肢体语言)与书面(缺乏这些)的具体差异。；- 找对比句式：看到 differences between A and B，寻找含有 "A is..., while B is..." 或 "Little of this is evident in..." 的对比句。 - 识别核心同义替换：written communication = written transcript。；定位失败 (未识别出文中的对比逻辑)
errors.src: 雅思阅读错题整理表 (Part 3: 历史研究与媒介)

errors.stem: Q28: The main reason why many historians are unwilling to use films in their work
errors.ev: (Para E) The barrier seems to be that the profession is structured around the medium of the written word... Above all, they have rejected the necessity to learn complicated new skills. (障碍似乎在于该行业是围绕书面文字媒介构建的...最重要的是，他们拒绝学习复杂新技能的必要性。)
errors.note: - 张冠李戴：B段讲的是学术界和大众缺乏交集（现象），而E段才直接解释了背后的核心原因（体制限制和不愿学新技能）。 - 未精准匹配题眼：题干问"main reason"，E段中的"The barrier"和"rejected"直接点出了原因。；- 寻找因果逻辑：匹配题看到 reason, cause 等词，重点寻找带有解释性、原因性的词汇（如 barrier, because, due to, result from）。 - 区分现象与原因：避免把文章描述的“现状”当成“原因”填入。；张冠李戴 (混淆了现象描述与深层原因)
errors.src: 雅思阅读错题整理表 (Part 3: 历史研究与媒介)

errors.stem: Q27: An overview of the range of methods that have been used over time to document history
errors.ev: (Para C) ...began with the transition from oral to literate culture... The next great shift came with the advent of printing... Today... faced with a variety of forms of communication, ranging from simple audiotape to... videodiscs. (始于从口头到读写文化的过渡...下一次转变是印刷术的出现...今天面临着各种交流形式，从录音带到影碟。)
errors.note: - 定位偏差：被A段提到的"written word"和"moving images"误导，以为这是方法的概述。 - 漏看逻辑词：题干重点在 over time（随时间推移），C段才完整列举了从古至今（oral, literate, printing, audiotape, videodiscs）的演变史。；- 抓时间线词：看到 over time, history, development 等词，立刻去寻找包含时间顺序或演变过程的段落。 - 区分现象与历史：A段只是对比现状（学术vs大众），C段才是宏观历史概述。；以偏概全 (只看到了局部词汇，未把握段落宏观逻辑)
errors.src: 雅思阅读错题整理表 (Part 3: 历史研究与媒介)

errors.stem: Bees need to balance the 23 _____ of each trip against the calorific rewards they obtain.
errors.ev: It must assess the quality and quantity of rewards which are on offer and juggle its energy costs so that it makes a calorific profit on each foraging trip. (必须评估奖励质量和数量，并平衡其能量成本，以便获得热量利润。)
errors.note: 没看懂对比关系。题目中的 "balance A against B (平衡A和B)"，B是 calorific rewards（热量回报），对应原文的 calorific profit。A 应该是 "energy costs"（能量成本）。；1. 抓取介词搭配：balance/juggle X against/so that Y。 2. 精读长难句，分清主语和宾语，不要被并列的 "quality and quantity" 迷惑。；偷换概念
errors.src: 雅思阅读错题整理表 (Part 3: 历史研究与媒介)

errors.stem: Approximately 21 _____ of human food production relies on the activity of bees.
errors.ev: Today about 15 per cent... account for another 15 per cent. It follows that around one third of our food is directly or indirectly dependent... (约15%...占另外15%。由此得出，约三分之一的食物...)
errors.note: 掉入数字干扰陷阱。原文先列举了两个 15%，最后总结 "around one third"（三分之一）。你只看到了前面的局部数字。；1. 警惕数字罗列处：看到多个数字，要找表示“总计/结论”的词，如 It follows that, total。 2. 带入检查：15%不符合approximately（大约）的宏观描述。；局部干扰
errors.src: 雅思阅读错题整理表 (Part 3: 历史研究与媒介)

errors.stem: Flowering plants started to reward bees with rich pollen and an additional food in the form of 20 _____.
errors.ev: ...providing richer sources of pollen and another source of nutrition, nectar. (...提供更丰富的花粉来源和另一种营养来源，花蜜。)
errors.note: 定位不准，抓错词。原文 "another source of nutrition, nectar" 明确指出了另一种食物是花蜜，而 "a succession" 在原文中描述的是植物和蜜蜂互相适应的过程。；1. 找并列结构：题干 and 并列了 pollen，原文也是 pollen and another... 2. 不要看到就近的词就填，要核对逻辑。                                    an additional food in the form of ____ = another source of nutrition, nectar；抓错宾语
errors.src: 雅思阅读错题整理表 (Part 3: 历史研究与媒介)

errors.stem: If the process of 22 _____ is to take place effectively, bees need to travel from one flower to another before going back to the nest.
errors.ev: ...a species which depends on cross-pollination is on a knife-edge: it must provide sufficient nectar... A satiated bee would return to its nest rather than visit another flower. (...依赖异花授粉的物种处于危险边缘...)
errors.note: 语法和逻辑错位。题目问的是什么“process (过程)”需要蜜蜂去另一朵花。原文说的是依赖 "cross-pollination"（异花授粉）的植物。填 foraging trip 逻辑不通。；1. 分析空格所在成分：of 后面接名词，表示某种过程。 2. 利用逆向思维：蜜蜂去另一朵花，是为了完成什么过程？自然是授粉。；未识别逻辑关系

errors.note: 原句：go to Northern Europe 陷阱：辅音+元音连读/同化。Northern 的结尾是 /n/，Europe 的开头是 /j/（类似拼音的y）。连在一起读变成 /ˈnɔːðən ˈjʊərəp/，听起来像“诺-登-纽罗普”。由于 -n 被弱读，您可能只听到了前面的 North。应对：注意拼写后缀 -ern，且 Europe 前多接形容词（Northern/Southern/Eastern/Western）。

errors.note: 陷阱：数字连读。比如 double five 会读成 /ˈdʌbl faɪv/，如果语速快，可能会把前面的尾音和后面的首音糊在一起（如 three seven 变成 /θriːsevn/）。应对：数字题必须每天练习速记，听到就写数字，不要写英文单词。

errors.stem: given a 8 ______ with accommodation
errors.note: 原句：give you a booklet 陷阱：尾音吞音。booklet 发音为 /ˈbʊklət/，中间的 /l/ 和结尾的 /t/ 在快速语流中非常轻，甚至会被吞掉。如果您只听到了前面的 book，就会漏掉后面的 -let。应对：遇到以 -let 结尾的词（如 leaflet 宣传单、booklet 小册子），要留意发音末尾是否有细微的“勒特”或短促的停顿。

errors.note: - 未识别同义替换：题干 "advantages > disadvantages" 完美对应原文的 "benefits easily outweigh worries"。 - D段只是说主流历史学家没有完全拒绝，且进行了一些有价值的研究，并未做优劣比较。；- 积累比较级/优劣势替换词：advantages = benefits/pros；disadvantages = worries/drawbacks/cons；greater than = outweigh。看到题干有比较，原文必有对应。；未识别同义替换 (未能将outweigh与greater than挂钩)
errors.src: 雅思阅读错题整理表 (Part 3: 历史研究与媒介)

errors.stem: These natural chemicals behave in a similar way to 39 ______, as they destroy harmful organisms.
errors.ev: ...so they act like natural pesticides, killing bacteria before they cause an infection.
errors.note: 同义替换未识别。题干中的“behave in a similar way to”替换了原文的“act like”。考生可能在听到后面的“bacteria”或“microorganisms”时发生了犹豫，错过了真正的核心词“pesticides（杀虫剂）”

errors.stem: when the 37 ______ on Caribbean sugar was removed
errors.ev: 原文：...the Canadian government decided to stop charging tax on Caribbean sugar, and this made it much cheaper. 错因：同义替换未识别 + 跨句干扰。题干里的 removed（移除/取消）同义替换了原文的 stop charging（停止征收）。您填的 alternative（替代品）可能是听到了前文的发音产生了联想，但完全不符合题干“加勒比糖的什么被取消了”的逻辑。
errors.note: 原文：...the Canadian government decided to stop charging tax on Caribbean sugar, and this made it much cheaper. 错因：同义替换未识别 + 跨句干扰。题干里的 removed（移除/取消）同义替换了原文的 stop charging（停止征收）。您填的 alternative（替代品）可能是听到了前文的发音产生了联想，但完全不符合题干“加勒比糖的什么被取消了”的逻辑。

errors.stem: Match activities: getting some work experience abroad -> 29 ______
errors.ans: A (broadens practical experience of the field)
errors.ev: ...and that would be a great way to find out how things are done elsewhere.
errors.note: 同义替换未识别。原文说去国外实习是了解“其他地方是怎么做事的”好方法，对应A选项的“拓宽该领域的实践经验”

errors.stem: Kathy and the tutor agree that she needs to A. do some more library research. B. record more data. C. narrow down her topic.
errors.ev: You've managed to avoid those twin traps.Q23However, I think you'd get more convincing results if you took some additional measurements
errors.note: 同义替换未识别。additional measurements（额外的测量）完美同义替换了B选项的 record more data（记录更多数据）。原文后面虽然提到了 library work，但被导师明确否定了 (don't think that's essential)，所以A错

errors.stem: The speaker stresses the importance to Clifton Bird Park of A. birds that are now endangered. B. birds from all over the world. C. birds that are common in the local area.
errors.ev: For some species that we have here, there aren't many still alive in the wild, so a big part of our job is to make sure we help their numbers increase.
errors.note: 同义替换未识别 + 掉入原词陷阱。您可能听到了最后一句 native species 就选了C，但原文强调的是“很多野生数量不多，需要帮它们繁衍”，这完美同义替换了A选项的 endangered（濒危的）

errors.stem: Memories from the past can make us feel like seeing an old 31 ______.
errors.ev: Even a photograph can awaken those memories... (翻译：哪怕是一张照片也能唤醒那些记忆...)
errors.note: 同义替换未精准抓取。原文后面虽然提到了“a single image”，但紧跟题目前半句“seeing an old”的对应词是“Even a photograph”。在填空题中，必须填原文原词，不能用近义词（image）代替

errors.stem: Bees were believed to be able to predict changes in 35 ______, based on their flight patterns...
errors.ev: Farmers and observers have long noticed that bee behavior is intricately linked to shifts in atmospheric conditions, making them reliable indicators of changing weather patterns. (翻译：蜜蜂的行为与大气条件的变化密切相关，使它们成为气候变化（天气模式）的可靠指标。)
errors.note: 字数超限/同义替换。题目明确要求 ONE WORD ONLY（只能填一个词）。即使您听到了 weather condition，也应该剔除修饰词只填核心词。此外，原文中“predict changes”对应了“indicators of changing”

errors.stem: Match Interview stages with problems: Closed questions: 29 ______
errors.ans: D (Not understanding the difference between truth and lies)
errors.ev: I think the stage called closed questions is easier for children to handle. They just have to answer yes or no. But everything's not so clear cut in a child's world, and abstract concepts such as honesty haven't been fully grasped by young children. (...但是儿童的世界没那么界限分明，像诚实这样的抽象概念，小孩子还没有完全掌握。)
errors.note: 未理解专业术语的同义替换。原文说孩子不明白“honesty（诚实）”这种抽象概念，对应的是选项D“不理解真相与谎言的区别”。您选的B在原文中并未提及

errors.stem: What concerns Eleanor and Jamie about the texts they have read so far? A. No clear conclusions are reached. B. The studies involved comparatively few people. C. Some of the data were gathered some time ago.
errors.ev: But actually, some of the cases are more than ten years old now. Well, it's the same problem with the survey reports our tutor gave us. (但是实际上，其中一些案例已经是十多年前的了...)
errors.note: 听到了原词但掉入陷阱。原文中确实出现了“conclusions（结论）”这个词，但原文说的是“the conclusions are clearly underlined（结论被清晰地画了下划线/标出）”，也就是有明确结论。而真正的问题在于“more than ten years old”，同义替换为C选项的“gathered some time ago（数据是以前收集的）”

errors.stem: The aim of the regular book reading is A. to sell more books. B. to bring authors together. C. to generate income by charging...
errors.ev: We don't make a charge for people to attend, but we obviously hope that some of them will want to purchase the book after listening... (翻译：我们不对参加活动的人收费，但我们显然希望他们能在听完后购买这本书...)
errors.note: 同义替换未识别。原文的“purchase the book（购买书籍）”完美对应A选项的“sell more books”。您选的B（把作者聚在一起）无中生有，原文提到的是作者来朗读她的最新小说

errors.stem: For parents to relax, the bookshop provides A. trained floor staff... B. a free nursery service. C. professional child care.
errors.ev: ...we decided to employ qualified nursery staff for parents' complete peace of mind. (翻译：我们决定雇佣合格的托儿所员工，让父母完全放心。)
errors.note: 同义替换未识别 + 掉入反义陷阱。原文中“qualified nursery staff”替换了“professional child care”。此外，原文明确提到“they do have to pay for this service”（这项服务必须付费），直接排除了B选项（免费的）

errors.stem: Match Sections of the report with Improvements: Manufacturing: 29 ______
errors.ev: I think some of the technical stuff about making the cloth could have been more clearly expressed... I think it would be much easier if we had some step-by-step drawings to go with the text.
errors.note: 同义替换未识别。原文提出的改进建议是加入 "step-by-step drawings"（分步图纸），对应C选项的 "visual illustrations"（视觉插图）

errors.stem: Match Sections of the report with Improvements: History: 27 ______
errors.ans: E (Make a prediction for the future)
errors.ev: I'd like you to use your knowledge of the past to say where you think the whole thing might go. Will jeans still be bestsellers, say, in ten years' time?
errors.note: 同义替换未识别。导师要求他们“说说未来会怎样（might go）”，并提到“十年后（ten years' time）”，直接对应E选项的“预测未来”

errors.stem: What do the students think is the main attraction of jeans for most people? A. they are long-lasting B. they are reasonably priced C. they are always in fashion
errors.ev: There's never been a time since then when they've been out of style. And although they're so durable, that's not what people think about these days. And the main attraction's certainly not price, because they can be extremely expensive.
errors.note: 反向干扰。原文明确排除了耐用（durable = A）和价格（certainly not price = B）。重点在 "never been out of style"（从未过时），同义替换为 "always in fashion"

errors.stem: Why did the students plan to use a cowboy film excerpt in their display? A. to provide a historical context... B. to show how the design was adapted... C. to illustrate why jeans became popular
errors.ev: ...the costume designs are accurate for the period, and it'll give our audience a feel for the sort of setting where jeans were worn at that time in America.
errors.note: 同义替换未识别。原文中的 "give our audience a feel for the sort of setting"（让观众感受当时的背景/环境）对应的就是A选项中的 "historical context"（历史背景）。您可能被后文提及的 "costume designs"（服装设计）误导，选了B

errors.stem: According to Claire, what makes the Emperor Hotel attractive to people? A. the chance to see famous people B. the friendliness of the staff C. the luxury of the surroundings
errors.ev: A lot of people come to see the expensive fabrics, antique carpets, and beautiful handmade furniture we have here.
errors.note: 同义替换未识别。原文用“expensive fabrics, antique carpets, beautiful handmade furniture”表达了酒店的“奢华（luxury）”，您可能被前面提到的“movie stars”等词误导，选择了A或B，但题干问的是“是什么吸引人们来”，重点是环境

errors.stem: One current limitation is that the substances become less effective when exposed to 40 ______.
errors.ev: However, they're not very effective in the presence of moisture.
errors.note: 同义替换未识别。题干中的“exposed to（暴露于）”被原文替换为“in the presence of（在...存在的情况下）”；同时考生容易被下一句解释原因的“Water”干扰

errors.stem: Air was removed from the sealed space and replaced with 36 ______.
errors.ev: The object was placed in a sealed environment where air was removed and replaced with nitrogen.
errors.note: 生词。因为生词“nitrogen（氮气）”注意“replaced with”是高频替换考点

errors.stem: 37 mental ability affected, e.g. decision-making, planning, which regulate our 38 ______
errors.ev: ...decision making ability and planning ability. And these are what control our performance.
errors.note: 同义替换未识别。题目中的“regulate”替换了原文的“control”。考生可能没有听到“performance”，而是听到了下一句紧随其后的“most sleepy”，从而错误地填了sleeping

errors.stem: Sources of information: • bibliography • library books • 28 ______
errors.ev: ...any other books and articles, you know, from the journals.
errors.note: 同义替换/词性错误。原文是“articles from the journals”，考点强调的是期刊中的文章，而非期刊本身
